crossRefs.note: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel.…
Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.
Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father…
If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

translations.web: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
translations.bsb: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.
translations.kjv: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
translations.asv: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate on thy statutes.
